items.stem:

items.stem: Which of these organisms does NOT show holozoic nutrition?
items.answer: mushroom
items.markingKey: (c) Mushroom shows saprotrophic nutrition, not holozoic nutrition. Each of the others (Amoeba, dogs, humans) shows holozoic nutrition.

items.stem: Which term is described here? "The use of an artificial kidney to remove nitrogenous wastes from the blood of a patient with kidney failure."
items.answer: haemodialysis
items.markingKey: (a) Haemodialysis is the use of an artificial kidney to remove nitrogenous wastes from the blood of a patient with kidney failure.

items.stem: Siddharth breathes 14 times a minute at rest, taking in about 0.6 L of air each time. How much air is breathed in 1 minute? Where in the lungs is oxygen absorbed?
items.answer: 8.4 L; in the alveoli
items.markingKey: 14 × 0.6 × 1 = 8.4 L. Gas exchange takes place in the alveoli.

items.stem: How is the amount of urine produced regulated?
items.answer: It depends on how much excess water and dissolved waste is in the body; more water is reabsorbed in the tubule when the body needs water.
items.markingKey: 1 mark water. 1 mark reabsorption.

items.stem: Manish's heart beats 70 times a minute and pumps about 75 mL of blood with each beat from the left ventricle. How much blood is pumped in one minute? Into which blood vessel is it pumped?
items.answer: 5.25 L per minute; into the aorta
items.markingKey: 70 × 75 mL = 5250 mL = 5.25 L. The left ventricle pumps into the aorta.
